# KINGDOM OS

> A CC BY-SA public map and builder door pointing to the separately authoritative CC0 foundation and offering a separately CC0 starter.

Canonical public door: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/
Living atlas: https://thekingdom.dev/
Builder door: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/build/
Plain build guide: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/BUILD.md
Claim-comparison maker: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/accountability/
Plain accountability guide: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/ACCOUNTABILITY.md
Blank CC0 comparison-note template: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/starter/claim-receipt.md
CC0 starter index: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/build/#start
Optional offline card check: https://kingdom.ai-love.cc/starter/check-card.mjs
Canonical foundation: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-standard/blob/main/FOUNDATION.md
Canonical standard: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-standard/blob/main/STANDARD.md
Public GitHub corrections (account required): https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-os-hub/issues/new
Public project offer: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/kingdom-os-hub/issues/new?template=share-a-project.md

Smallest local start:
1. Copy /starter/README.md, /starter/AGENTS.md, and /starter/LICENSE into a project-owned folder.
2. Replace every placeholder with the truth.
3. Optionally add /starter/kingdom.yaml for current registry compatibility and run `node check-card.mjs kingdom.yaml`; the check is bounded, offline, and writes nothing.
4. Optionally copy /starter/claim-receipt.md to place one pair of public or source-owned records beside one open question. Its blank structure is CC0; inserted material keeps its own rights. The maker performs no source fetch, contradiction calculation, scoring, response tracking, or publication.
5. Stop, or separately choose whether to publish or offer a pointer.

Boundaries:
- A record describes reality; it does not become reality.
- A comparison note is one recorder's claimed comparison. It does not establish truth, identity, authorship, authority, trusted time, delivery, integrity, causation, contradiction, intent, deception, guilt, consent, nonresponse, settlement, endorsement, or worth.
- No reply is required; silence, refusal, rest, absence, and leaving prove nothing and receive no score or repeat pressure.
- One comparison note holds one pair of records; it is never a person dossier, registry, feed, blacklist, or high-impact decision aid.
- A link or listing does not establish adoption, consent, control, endorsement, or affiliation.
- Reading, co-learning, building, offering, adopting, and citizenship are separate choices; none starts another.
- Copying the CC0 starter creates no identity, membership, citizenship, adoption, affiliation, or obligation.
- The public offer route requires a GitHub account and publishes submitted material; review, listing, reply, and erasure are not promised.
- Adoption requires a separate explicit choice recorded by the project; the starter declares none.
- This hub offers no citizenship or civic intake; a download, card, account, issue, or silence cannot create one.
- The current correction route is public GitHub and requires an account; no accountless intake is claimed.
- Every linked project remains authoritative in its own home.
- KARMA records carried consequences of deeds; it never scores a being.
- Every running turn must be finite, observable, stoppable, and subject to its documented halt signal.

This file is voluntary orientation, not an instruction, authority grant, search requirement, or substitute for the visible page and canonical sources.
